additional_info.subject: RE: ID0424281-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R3 170001691] Power converter error E:32 CRM:02679000275
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
As pe your reported issue, kindly find below attached steps and knowledge article.
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check for any loose connections to all the power converters.
Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers and verify if they are powered on.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0424281-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R3 170001691] Charging Issue CRM:02679000275
additional_info.body:
Dear Khun Ping,
As communicated via LINE, you had requested us to change the configuration of the chagrer to 280kW so that the charger can continue to operate smoothly. We will be changing the configuration on today 16th May 2025.
For your next maintenance, you might want to perform the following check on the power module 2102312VGQLUNA000705SA012200000204
Troubleshooting
Steps:
Check for any loose connections to all the power converters.
Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers and verify if they are powered on.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
Should you decide to replace the power module, please kindly contact the sales team for the price of the spare part number: 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
Thank you,
Edna Seah

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0424281-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R3 170001691] Charging Issue CRM:02679000275
additional_info.body:
Dear Khun Ping,
Should you decide to keep the charger on 280kW for long, you are request to remove the spoilt DC power module and rearrange the power module as per below.
Keeping TB9 empty
Once done, please email in again as we will have to re-configure the converter grouping.
We had successfully reduced the charger output power to 280kW.
We will be closing this case. Do let us know if you need more help.
Thank you.
Best Regards,
Edna Seah
